description: Independent private-veth measurements on Linux 6.8. All throughput and latency derive from original organizer Go histograms. No public leaderboard submission.
host: Linux 6.8.0-147-generic, AMD EPYC-Genoa KVM guest, 16 logical CPUs and one thread per core

interpretation.server_core_us_per_request: Inclusive physical CPU10 user+system+nice+irq+softirq. The XDP driver runs the redirect on the transmitting client CPU on this veth; this measurement alone understates that mode's ingress cost.
interpretation.combined_server_and_client_core_us_per_r: Sum of all physical server and client busy-core time per completed request, including the stock Go load generators.
interpretation.client_wire_checksums: The three matched arms sharing this setting charge checksum completion to the Linux sender. Changing the setting also changes the private client's TSO feature mask.

post_close.reason: The initial log sampler exited after reading a partly written stats line during disconnect.
